summary: Explains how per-mesh Signed Distance Fields and the Global Distance Field work (used for DFAO, DF shadows, GPU particle collision, and Lumen software ray tracing), how to enable and visualize them, tune resolution, and set up foliage.
gotchas: Generated offline; cannot be generated at runtime
Only rigid meshes cast DF shadows; skeletal meshes need Capsule Shadows
WPO/displacement deformation causes self-shadowing artifacts; non-uniform scaling not handled correctly
Enabling Generate Mesh Distance Fields requires an editor restart; max 256 voxels per axis per mesh

summary: Programmer guide to the renderer's retained-mode mesh drawing path: FPrimitiveSceneProxy to FMeshBatch to FMeshDrawCommand, writing custom FMeshPassProcessor passes, cached draw commands, dynamic instancing and GPU Scene.
gotchas: Renderer not extensible from plugins; new passes (except DrawDynamicMeshPass) require renderer module changes
Invalidating all cached commands (bScenesPrimitivesNeedStaticMeshElementUpdate) causes hitches during gameplay
Only FLocalVertexFactory draws can be cached and dynamically instanced
Loose shader parameters or per-draw bindings prevent draw call merging

summary: Hub page linking to mobile rendering docs: features reference, forward/deferred shading modes, Mobile FSR, desktop renderer on mobile, Lumen on mobile, and frame pacing.

Overview of Nanite: how it works, which meshes should use it, how to enable it on import, per-asset or in batch, its feature set (skeletal meshes, landscapes, foliage, splines, displacement, tessellation) and what geometry, material and rendering features are unsupported.
gotchas: Only Opaque and Masked blend modes; unsupported materials get a default material with an Output Log warning
No Morph Targets, Forward Rendering, MSAA, Lighting Channels, VR stereo, distance/min-screen-radius culling
Requires DirectX 12 with SM6; hard limit of 16 million instances in scene
WPO displacement must be clamped; Custom nodes/POM may artifact; ray tracing uses Fallback Mesh unless r.RayTracing.Nanite.Mode 1 (experimental)

summary: Hub page for the Beta Neural Network Engine (NNE), a common API for running neural network inference; links to NNE overview, quick start, NNE/NFOR denoisers, neural post processing, ML Deformer and ML cloth.
gotchas: Beta feature; use caution when shipping

summary: Hub page for rendering optimization: links to real-time guidelines, forward renderer, screen percentage/dynamic resolution, config files and scalability, stat commands, Nanite/LODs/texture streaming/culling, RenderDoc, Unreal Insights, GPUDump, Render Resource Viewer, Primitive Debugger and GPU crash pages.

How to set a Camera actor to Orthographic projection (e.g. isometric games), its Ortho Width and clip-plane settings, and console variables for auto planes, view-origin correction, VSM clipmap tuning, debug forcing, and depth/fog adjustments.
gotchas: Cinematic cameras have no orthographic option
Debug ortho cvars are disabled in shipping builds
Newer features may not be optimized for orthographic; VSM with mixed Nanite/non-Nanite is tricky
Volumetric clouds render poorly in orthographic views

summary: Explains the Game/Render/RHI thread split, how FRHICommand command lists are recorded and translated via IRHICommandContext, frame synchronization, and cvars to disable parallel rendering for debugging.
gotchas: r.rhicmdbypass is ignored unless the RHI Thread is disabled

summary: Full guide to the hardware-accelerated Path Tracer: enabling it, using it in the viewport and Movie Render Queue, PathTracing post-process settings, denoisers, sky/atmosphere/fog, glass and absorption materials, supported-feature table, useful cvars and FAQ (HighResShot, runtime node, TDR timeouts, Nanite).
gotchas: Requires Hardware Ray Tracing, DirectX 12 and an RTX/DXR GPU
Moving lights, skinned meshes, Niagara and WPO do not invalidate accumulation, causing streaking in editor; use MRQ
HDRIBackdrop is incompatible (double-counted lighting)
Heavy scenes can trigger D3D device-removed timeouts; tune r.PathTracing.DispatchSize/FlushDispatch

summary: Guidelines for the PBR material inputs Base Color, Roughness, Metallic and Specular, with measured real-world values, how to map roughness/metallic, and using cavity maps.
gotchas: Treat Metallic as binary (0 or 1) except for hybrid surfaces
Leave Specular at default 0.5; do not set to 0 for diffuse materials, raise Roughness instead
Specular input is not for reflection/variation maps; use Roughness maps

summary: Reference for Post Process Volume settings (Priority, Blend Radius, Infinite Extent) and each category: lens effects (DOF, bloom, exposure, chromatic aberration, flares, vignette), color grading/film tonemapper, GI and reflection method selection, post process materials, SSAO/RTAO, motion blur, path tracing and film grain.
gotchas: Ray Tracing GI, Ray Tracing Reflections and Ray Tracing Translucency are deprecated and may be removed
Ray tracing options require Support Hardware Ray Tracing and DirectX 12
Default post settings apply even without a volume; configured in Project Settings > Rendering > Default Settings
Overlapping volumes with equal Priority have undefined order

summary: Hub page for hardware ray tracing and path tracing: system requirements and links to Hardware Ray Tracing, Path Tracer, ray tracing performance guide, tips and tricks, MRQ high-quality frames, and the properties reference.
gotchas: Requires Windows 10 1809+ (or Vulkan desktop), DXR-capable NVIDIA RTX/GTX GPU, and the Deferred rendering path

summary: Compares UE reflection systems (Lumen Reflections, Ray Tracing Reflections, Screen Space Reflections, Reflection Captures, Planar Reflections) by type and platform, and how to enable High Precision Normals for higher-quality reflections.
gotchas: Ray Tracing Reflections are deprecated and may be removed
SSR cannot reflect off-screen or occluded objects
Planar Reflections re-render the scene and are costly

summary: C++ programming guide to the Render Dependency Graph (RDG): shader parameter structs, uniform buffers and static bindings, FRDGBuilder passes/resources, raster/compute/async compute passes, external and transient resources, uploads, memory lifetimes, profiling scopes, and debugging/validation tools including RDG Insights.
gotchas: Only one graph builder instance may exist at a time; API is single-threaded
RHI resources only accessible inside pass lambdas that declare them; GetRHI elsewhere asserts
Transient resources have garbage prior contents; don't rely on previous data
Validation layer only in Debug/Development; compiled out in Test/Shipping

summary: Explains the Render Resource Viewer (Tools menu), which snapshots GPU memory allocations per render resource with name, size, type, flags and owning asset, with filters, search and browse-to-asset, for finding what uses VRAM.
gotchas: Snapshot taken when opened; does not update until Refresh is clicked
Owner shows None for untracked resource types (tracked: static/skeletal meshes, textures, grooms)

summary: Brief descriptions of rendering component types: fog, Billboard and Material Billboard, Custom/Poseable mesh, Decal, Instanced Static Mesh, Particle System, Post Process, Scene Capture 2D/Cube, Spline Mesh and Text Render components.
gotchas: SceneCaptureCubeComponent is very expensive; use only when necessary
Page is legacy (references AtmosphericFog and Cascade)

summary: Step-by-step tutorial using the ArchViz Interior sample to render a high-quality image sequence with Movie Render Queue: enabling the plugin, output formats, anti-aliasing samples, quality/ray tracing cvars, output range, saving presets, and avoiding GPU timeouts.
gotchas: Windows 10 64-bit; sample needs DX12 ray tracing GPU
Alpha output needs Enable alpha channel support in post processing (experimental) and a restart
r.D3D12.GPUTimeout=0 can freeze the PC; editing TDR requires admin rights
Remote render farm integration requires C++

summary: Graphics-programmer notes on writing .usf shaders: global vs material vs mesh-material shaders, vertex factories, FMaterialShaderMap, asynchronous compilation via Shader Compile Workers, caching/cooking, and debugging/iteration tips.
gotchas: Global shader compile failure is fatal; enable r.ShaderDevelopmentMode to retry
r.DumpShaderDebugInfo left on fills the disk with many small files
Disabling worker/async compiling makes compilation single-core and slow

summary: Hub page linking to an overview of shaders in plugins and a guide to creating a new global shader as a plugin.
